players.product: blank masks for semiconductor and display photomasks (EUV blank mask in mass-production preparation; EUV pellicle in development)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (consolidated, K-IFRS): Q2 2026 revenue KRW 66,414,654,618 vs KRW 60,671,932,959 in Q2 2025; Q2 operating profit KRW 13,595,004,251 vs KRW 13,293,171,706; Q2 net income KRW 12,743,146,266 vs KRW 10,090,029,110. H1 2026 revenue KRW 128,106,371,358 vs KRW 118,576,163,378 in H1 2025; H1 operating profit KRW 24,971,051,485 vs KRW 25,168,835,799; H1 net income KRW 26,536,020,431 vs KRW 21,998,366,204. Blank masks for semiconductor and FPD were KRW 125,072,500K (97.6%) of H1 revenue (domestic KRW 54,033,411K, export KRW 71,039,089K); the rest is the venture-investment and bio/lab-rental subsidiaries. Product and processing sales in Q2 were KRW 64,841,216,528 vs KRW 59,036,824,056. Four customers above the disclosure threshold (names undisclosed) bought KRW 28,675,238,299, KRW 24,689,083,155, KRW 12,981,531,708 and KRW 10,889,989,000 in H1 (H1 2025: KRW 20,339,222,000, KRW 21,696,717,981, KRW 10,430,623,954, KRW 15,958,811,500). R&D spend KRW 7,558,666K = 5.9% of revenue. FY2025 reference: revenue KRW 243,733,253K, up 38.5% YoY.

Capacity: blank-mask lines at the Daegu HQ and plant ran 27,480 of 32,832 available hours in H1 2026, an average utilisation of 83.7%. Raw-material purchases (quartz etc., the main blank-mask input) were KRW 69,175,348K in H1; raw-material inventory rose to KRW 34,553,175,258 from KRW 28,948,727,315 at year-end. The company sells on customers' short-term purchase orders under master supply agreements, so it keeps no order backlog and has no individual supply contracts beyond those agreements.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 utilisation 83.7% (27,480 of 32,832 hours); raw-material purchases KRW 69,175,348K

quarterly_data.signal: EUV investment: the Yongin 'EUV Center' was completed in October 2025 and mass-production preparation of related products is under way. The KRW 41,728M facility investment for EUV blank-mask mass-production preparation (12-04-2024 to 02-28-2026) was completed in February 2026. H1 2026 purchases of property, plant and equipment were KRW 30,739,616,937 (H1 2025: KRW 14,441,521,208); construction in progress stood at KRW 56,680,817,614 and contracted capital expenditure for property, plant and equipment at KRW 65,437,351,458 at 06-30-2026 (KRW 41,195,033,950 at year-end).
quarterly_data.figure: EUV blank-mask mass-production prep capex KRW 41,728M completed Feb 2026; H1 PP&E purchases KRW 30,739,616,937; PP&E capex commitments KRW 65,437,351,458

quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook in the half-year report: demand is expected to grow for high-end semiconductor products centred on major customers and for display products as OLED adoption widens, and overseas demand is expected to continue on the back of capacity investment by Chinese foundries and panel makers; the company notes China's push to localise its supply chain is accelerating fabless and foundry growth and, with OLED expansion, blank-mask demand is rising quickly. Subsequent event: subsidiary S&S Advanced Materials Limited decided on 07-02-2026 to invest in S&S Suzhou Corp. and plans to invest USD 40,000,000 by June 2031 (the report does not state the Suzhou unit's activity); a Singapore holding subsidiary (S&S MATERIAL PTE. LTD.) was set up on 04-20-2026 and a Hong Kong subsidiary was approved by the board on 06-02-2026.
quarterly_data.figure: USD 40,000,000 planned investment in S&S Suzhou Corp. by June 2031

contracts.signal: Half-year report, transactions with interested parties: S&S Tech sold blank masks to Samsung Electronics, which holds 8.0% of its shares (1,716,116 shares), worth KRW 7,824 million in H1 2026 vs KRW 6,613 million in H1 2025.
